Design handover · Seller wallet · Taiwan

My Balance, TW NewebPay order type — Handover

TW sellers can be paid two ways: 7-Eleven Cash on Delivery (money lands in the Carousell wallet) and NewebPay (the buyer pays by credit/debit card and the money goes to the seller's NewebPay account). This handover covers only what is different on My Balance when the seller has NewebPay orders, in the app and on desktop web. Everything else on the screen is the Cash on Delivery build and is not repeated here.

01

Read first
Why the screen looks like this. NewebPay can't give Carousell the amount available to withdraw, or any withdrawal history. So the page never shows a NewebPay amount or total, and the seller withdraws NewebPay money on NewebPay's website.
  • Two withdrawals sit side by side in one "Ready to withdraw" card, with no total: NewebPay balance (no amount, its Withdraw is always active, it leaves Carousell) and General balance (the amount, withdrawn in the app, disabled at NT$0).
  • Pending earnings is one figure covering every pending order, General and NewebPay.
  • Transaction history keeps the General states and adds the NewebPay states, with NewebPay / General chips.
  • A 3-step tour and a NewebPay balance info sheet are new.
  • Desktop web (section "Desktop web") is the same design in production's desktop layout, with the two cards stacked full width. Production has no TW desktop wallet, and 7-Eleven Cash on Delivery has no desktop page.
  • Money out never carries a seller fee. Every money-in row does, including NewebPay's. The amount on a money-in row is net of the seller fee (the fee is already taken off), and the fee is shown under it as information only. NewebPay follows the same rule as Cash on Delivery.
  • 12 checkpoints at the end; the ones that block a build are #1 and #2.

02

Components used

TopNavTitleAction (title "My Balance")

  • Import / source: @/components/design-system/top-nav/title-action-v2
  • Native mapping: not documented
  • Props used: title="My Balance", titleType="normal", leftIcon="Arrow Back", right slot = Settings gear (only when there is money, pending or ready) + Info icon (replays the tour)

Button

  • Import / source: @/components/design-system/button
  • Native mapping: Android DonutButton; iOS PrimaryPromoteButton, PrimaryTaskButton, SecondaryButton (from the Figma component description)
  • Props used: the two Withdraw buttons are variant="primary" primaryVariant="task" size="medium" (40px high); "Got it" is size="large" fullWidth (48px); "View all transactions" and "Learn more" are variant="text" size="none"

Chip / ChipGroup

  • Import / source: @/components/design-system/input/chip
  • Props used: variant="single" size="small" (32px high), labels All / NewebPay / General

Tabs (Transaction history only)

  • Import / source: @/components/design-system/tabs
  • Props used: three triggers All / Money In / Money Out (default variant="normal")

BottomSheet (NewebPay balance info sheet)

  • Import / source: @/components/design-system/bottom-sheet
  • Props used: title="NewebPay balance", footer = the "Got it" button. It has no close X: the kit shows the X only on full-height sheets, so an auto-height sheet is dismissed by "Got it", the backdrop, or dragging the handle.

Tour: CoachMarkDim / CoachMarkTarget / CoachMarkTip + SpeechBubble

  • Import / source: @/components/prototype/coach-mark, @/components/design-system/speech-bubble
  • Props used: SpeechBubble tipPosition="top" with actions (Learn more, Next / Done), className="max-w-none"; tip inset px-space-md

TagBadge, SystemIcon

  • TagBadge variant="generic-low" for "Pending order completion" and "Pending return/refund resolution" (Figma "Tag Generic", Donut 2.0).
  • SystemIcon name="action/help" (16px) for the ⓘ. Use the grey 16px export (public/icons/system/action/16_help.svg, fill #57585A). Do not use state/16_info.svg: its fill is baked teal.
  • Transaction icons are six custom 32px assets: public/icons/system/transaction/32_{bank,cash}_{success,pending,fail}.svg. Bank = a transfer, cash = an order; tick = done, clock = on its way, cross = failed or reversed.

One-offs (not design-system components)

  • Balance row (BalanceRow in wallet-content.tsx): built on Button + two text lines. A label line, then either a helper line (NewebPay) or an amount line (General), and its Withdraw button bottom-aligned.
  • Transaction row (TxnRow): icon, a text column, an amount column. Spec below.
  • Cards: plain bordered boxes (rounded-lg border border-stroke-boundary), no card component.

05

Interaction mechanics

No gesture beyond a tap, plus the sheet's drag handle.

  • Tour (auto-open). Opens by itself on entry when the seller has pending or ready earnings (prototype rule; the production frequency rule is checkpoint 3). "Next" advances; "Done" on step 3 closes. "Learn more" does nothing yet (checkpoint 2). The Info icon in the top nav replays the tour from step 1 (scrolls to top first). While the tour is open, taps on the underlying controls are ignored. Steps swap instantly: no fade, slide or timing.
  • Tapping the ⓘ opens the info sheet (ignored while the tour is open).
  • Info sheet motion. Opens with animate-in slide-in-from-bottom over 300ms. It closes instantly (it unmounts), whether from "Got it", a backdrop tap, or a drag. Drag the handle down: it dismisses when pulled past 25% of its height or flicked faster than 0.5px/ms; otherwise it snaps back. Mouse and touch behave the same (pointer events).
  • Withdraw buttons. General opens the TW bank-account form, the same as Cash on Delivery (ignored while the tour is open). NewebPay's is not wired yet (checkpoint 1).
  • Chips. Tap to filter the list instantly; one chip selected at a time; "All" is the default. The choice is kept while the page is open and becomes the starting chip on Transaction history. Changing a chip on Transaction history does not change the home chip. A new scenario (market, order type or earnings) resets it to All.
  • Pending card opens the Pending earnings screen (a plain swap; back returns). It lists the pending rows under "Transaction in progress" with one total at the top.
  • "View all transactions" opens Transaction history. Tabs and chips filter instantly; no transitions.
  • Settings gear (only when there is money): on TW it opens the existing "Verify your phone number" alert; unchanged from the baseline.
  • Every other state change is an instant swap with no transition.

Motion spec

N/A — the only animation is the info sheet's 300ms slide-in, described above.

Transaction states on the NewebPay order type

NewebPay states (Figma "Transaction States for NewebPay"; amounts NT$, copy verbatim):

#RowStatus lineAmountIcon
1Transfer to NewebPay WalletAuto-transferred to your NewebPay Wallet.-NT$260bank, tick
2Transfer to NewebPay WalletAuto-transfer failed. {Reason}-NT$260 struckbank, cross
3@Mejuri's orderOrder completed. Ready to withdraw+NT$26 green, fee NT$6cash, tick
4@Mejuri's order, tag "Pending order completion"Ready to withdraw once the order is complete+NT$26, fee NT$6cash, clock
5@Mejuri's orderRefunded to buyer (Return/refund request)+NT$26 struck, fee NT$6cash, cross
6@Mejuri's orderReversed due to order cancellation+NT$26 struck, fee NT$6cash, cross
7@Mejuri's order, tag "Pending return/refund resolution"Issue raised by buyer (Return/refund request)+NT$26, fee NT$6cash, clock
8@Mejuri's orderTransaction suspended+NT$26 struck, fee NT$6cash, cross

General states (unchanged from Cash on Delivery, tagged General): Transfer completed (see it in your bank within 1-4 working days), Transfer in progress, Transfer in progress for one order (-NT$26), Bank verification failed (check your bank details or try another account), then Order completed, Pending order completion, Pending return/refund resolution, each with the seller fee on the order rows.

Rules that apply to both groups:

  • Money out (transfers) never has a seller fee. Money in (orders) always does.
  • Struck amounts are line-through; only a completed order's amount is green.
  • Which chip a row belongs to is a backend fact and is never shown on the row.
  • NewebPay money out is only the transfers into the NewebPay wallet. Withdrawals out of NewebPay are not available and never listed.

09

Decisions already made
  • No NewebPay amount, balance, total, or withdrawal history anywhere. NewebPay can't provide them.
  • "Ready to withdraw" holds two peer withdrawals: NewebPay (outside Carousell) and General (in app). Neither is a destination of the other's button.
  • NewebPay's Withdraw is always active; General's is disabled at NT$0.
  • Pending earnings is one figure. A "Pending return/refund resolution" order counts as pending.
  • NewebPay and General orders complete on the same rule (buyer confirms receipt, or the order auto-completes).
  • The "Transaction States for NewebPay" frame is the NewebPay states only; the General states stay.
  • General Withdraw on the NewebPay order type works like Cash on Delivery: it opens the TW bank-account form.
  • The Pending earnings card keeps its chevron and stays tappable on NewebPay. The Pending earnings screen uses the Cash on Delivery layout: one total, then the pending rows.
  • NewebPay has no "Auto-transfer in progress" state. Sellers only need to know the money arrived in their NewebPay wallet.
  • Desktop web: 7-Eleven Cash on Delivery has no desktop balance page. TW NewebPay has one, converted from the app design: both cards stacked full width, the Pending card keeps its chevron, seller fee and "What is seller fee?" stay, the chips stay. Production's TW desktop page (a "check the app" dead end) is not used.
  • Money-out states never carry a seller fee; money-in states always do, including NewebPay's.
  • The amount on a money-in row is net of the seller fee, so the fee is not subtracted again: +NT$26 with "Seller Fee: NT$6" means the seller received NT$26 from an order total of NT$32. This is production's rule for TW Cash on Delivery (the wallet credit is price + logistics − seller fee, and the app prints the amount and the fee as two separate values). NewebPay follows the current flow (confirmed by design).
  • Label stays "NewebPay balance" (a balance with no number, explained by the helper and the ⓘ).

Desktop web

The prototype's wallet page has an App / Dweb chip above the screen. Production's desktop wallet lives in carousell/mweb (src/pages/ProfileWalletBalance). For TW, production's desktop page is only a dead end ("We're working to make it better for you! In the meantime, check out your Balance on the Carousell app"), so there is no desktop wallet to copy for NewebPay. The NewebPay desktop page is the app design converted to the existing desktop layout. The mockup was approved in chat in Oct 2026; there is no Figma frame.

Layout structure (main column of the account shell)

The shell is the existing account layout: 262px menu, the main column, a 184px ad rail. Measured with the desktop window at 1280px wide (the main column is then 656px).

- Page header: "My Balance"                          [gear] [ⓘ help]     (unchanged from production)

Stacked on purpose. Production's desktop puts the two cards side by side (the pending card is a 240px card). NewebPay stacks them like the app so both cards use the full width.

Desktop: the "Ready to withdraw" card

  • Card: padding 32, radius 8, 1px border stroke-boundary, shadow-sm, bg background-base. 291 high with both rows. 24px between the title and each row.
  • Title "Ready to withdraw": Text size l, 20 / 28, 400, text-content-primary.
  • NewebPay row: label "NewebPay balance" 16 / 24, 400, primary, then a 16px ⓘ button. Helper "Check on their website" 14 / 22, text-content-secondary. The row's Withdraw button is on the right, always active.
  • A 1px stroke-boundary divider between the rows.
  • General row: label "General balance" 16 / 24 primary, amount Heading level 2, 30 / 38, 600. Its Withdraw button is on the right, disabled at NT$0.
  • Buttons: DonutButton primaryTask, size m, 40 high, about 105 wide, radius 4, 16 / 600. Rows are bottom-aligned (the button lines up with the last text line).
  • No total anywhere in the card.

Desktop: the "Pending earnings" card

  • Full width (656), padding 24, radius 8, 1px border stroke-boundary, bg background-display (≈ #f7f7f8). 120 high.
  • Label "Pending earnings": 16 / 24, 400, text-content-primary (the same as the app's NewebPay card). Amount: Heading level 2, 30 / 38, 600. The same sizes as SG's pending card.
  • Chevron (24px, content-secondary) at the top right, same as the app. The figure is one number: the sum of every pending row.

Desktop: transaction history

  • Heading Heading level 3, 24 / 32, 600. "What is seller fee?" is a text-type DonutButton on the right (kept from the app; production's desktop history does not have it).
  • Chips: web Chip ×3 (All, NewebPay, General), single select, "All" by default. They filter on the same hidden payment type as the app and are not shown on a row.
  • Rows (same data and copy as the app): 32px status icon, then title 14 / 22, meta line "03 Oct, 2:14PM ・Order ID: 2041187653", status line in text-branding-external-ad (blue) or text-content-negative (red). Amount right-aligned, 600, green for money in that is ready, struck through for money that never moved. Seller fee under the amount, 12 / 20, text-content-secondary, on order rows only; transfers carry none. Order rows end with a 16px chevron; transfers leave the slot empty so the amounts line up.
  • Pending order rows carry the tag "Pending order completion" or "Pending return/refund resolution" above the title.

Interaction and states

  • Tour. Opens on entry. Steps 1 and 2 both light up the card (different copy); step 3 lights up the pending card. "Next" advances and "Done" on step 3 closes it. The help icon (top right) replays it from step 1. Production web shows the tour once per account (a "seen" flag in local storage) and the help icon replays it; the prototype opens it on every entry. The prototype does not dim the page behind the bubble (production does), so the scenario panel stays usable.
  • ⓘ info modal. A small desktop modal titled "NewebPay balance" with a close X, the body copy, "Learn more" (does nothing yet) and "Got it". The app's bottom sheet has no close icon; the desktop modal keeps the platform's close X.
  • Chips filter instantly. The choice is kept while the page is open.
  • Withdraw buttons, the Pending card, the gear and "What is seller fee?" do nothing yet in the prototype (see checkpoints).
  • Earnings states are the same four as the app (None, Pending only, Has earnings, All states). None shows NT$0 on General, the NewebPay helper, and the empty-history art with "Your transactions will show up here when buyers pay you via the 'Buy' button." The tour opens in every state, as in production.
  • Narrow windows. The prototype's window is a fixed 1280px. Nothing is designed for narrower widths.

Scenario config

The wallet page also has an App / Dweb chip above the screen (the view, not a scenario axis); the axes below drive both views.

ScenarioConfigPanel axes: Market (SG / MY / HK / TW); Order type (TW only: 7-Eleven Cash on Delivery / NewebPay); Earnings (None / Pending only / Has earnings / All states). The panel is reviewer chrome. The prototype also renders the screen inside a single labelled phone ("Seller app / My Balance") on a wide page.

Screenshots are real captures of the prototype (TW; app 390 × 844, desktop 1280 × 844) taken on 2026-10-14 and 2026-10-16. Amounts and names are sample data. If the prototype changes, this page and the markdown doc need re-capturing and updating together.
